descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-15 Ask AI · S23 Existing api specs: question routing and the patient block's tracker lines

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Each of the six quick-question presets (today's labs, current medications, pre-round note contents, urgent pending tasks, current diagnosis, symptoms mentioned) returns a correct, patient-specific an … (UAT TC-15; TFA-92593 AC 4)
  • U5 The current-medications answer reflects the Medication Tracker; held drugs show as held. (UAT TC-15; TFA-92593 AC 7)
  • T3 Ask AI prompt, context blocks and question routing match the p72 prototype unless Vikram approved a change. (TFA-94229 AC 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given e2e/api/ask-context.spec.ts

When Run the four titles

Then Each question routes to the prototype's emphasis (first match wins); the patient block carries every prototype section with HELD / STOPPED / ONE-TIME DOSES GIVEN lines; today's unsaved dictation outranks the saved note; prior encounters are bounded to the admission

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): The existing assertions (deterministic input to U1 routing and U5). They prove what the context carries, not what the model says

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method UNIT · Unit test; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S23 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-15.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: UNIT · Unit test — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-15 Ask AI · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-15/S23

Existing api specs: question routing and the patient block's tracker lines

Tickets: TFA-92593 Ask AI (ready for qa); TFA-94229 Port & preserve Vikram's clinical AI logic (in progress)

  • api/ask-context.spec.ts [api] — questions route to the prototype's emphasis, first match wins — expected
  • api/ask-context.spec.ts [api] — the patient block carries every prototype section and names the query type — expected
  • api/ask-context.spec.ts [api] — today's unsaved dictation outranks the saved encounter note — expected
  • api/ask-context.spec.ts [api] — prior encounters are bounded to this admission, undated ones kept — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's api spec e2e/api/ask-context.spec.ts): it checks classifyQuery / buildAskContext / resolveTemporalQuery in-process from the QA worktree and calls no deployment, so there is nothing to run on dev; it runs with the local suite (Quinn 2026-10-14)..
